revision_trigger.interpretation: V1 pooled near-zero CLR innovations across territories and doubled them to obtain aggregate coverage. This produced non-credible near-monopoly draws and failed the legal prior-predictive gate. No forecast artifact or seat result existed when V2 was frozen.

robust_simplex_projection.floor_rule: Replace s by floor + (1-K*floor)*s for K=9 before concentration tempering.
robust_simplex_projection.max_bucket_share_cap_rule: min(0.85, max observed 9-bucket share across every local row in 2011/2016/2021 + 0.05)
robust_simplex_projection.concentration_tempering: If max share exceeds the cap, find tau in (0,1] by deterministic bisection so normalize(s**tau) has max exactly equal to the cap.
robust_simplex_projection.reason: Bound transport of structural zero/near-zero CLR shocks without deleting their direction or using any 2026 outcome.

candidate_selection.vote: Among candidates meeting aggregate componentwise coverage thresholds and robust-simplex invariants, select lowest Energy Score, then lower scale. If none meet coverage, fail rather than widen past the frozen grid.
candidate_selection.turnout: Unchanged V1 selection rule: among candidates meeting coverage thresholds select lowest CRPS, then lower scale.

required: all simulated 9-bucket shares finite and normalized
minimum bucket share >= 0.0005 minus numerical tolerance
maximum bucket share <= empirical cap plus numerical tolerance
selected vote and turnout candidates meet frozen coverage thresholds
all candidate metrics and V1 comparison retained
prior_predictive_gate.forecast_gate: V2 calibration must pass before F-1 protocol may be amended or rerun.

legal_list_availability_boundary.F_minus_1: Only lists with positive 2021 votes in the contest are eligible. Absent core-bucket mass is renormalized over observed 2021 lists; verified new 2026 lists belong to B2/F0 or later.
legal_list_availability_boundary.reason: F-1 must not invent a filed list merely because a fixed structural bucket exists.
